correctness.rationale: For the uniform vertex-cutting process, condition first on which current source-component vertex is selected. When one target remains active on an arm of length c and the other arm is inert of length d, F_c(d;z)=z(c+1+sum_{h<d}F_c(h;z))/(c+d+1), solving to Q_c(d)=(c+1)prod_{k=c+1}^{c+d}(1+z/k). Conditioning on the first cut with two active endpoint targets gives E[z^(S-1)] as the sum of two Bernoulli PGFs minus one. Coefficient comparison yields P(S=1)=1/N and exact TV(S-1,A)=a/N, TV(S-1,B)=b/N. Taylor logs of products yield macroscopic interior PGF and normalized positive-Poisson mixture. At a/N->0, TV transfer to independent Bernoulli A with mean H_N-H_(a+1)->infty and asymptotic variance proves the Gaussian crossover. Independent exact-rational Markov recursion checked 36 ordered (a,b) cases; asymptotic quantifiers rely on proof.
